screen.label: result
screen.source: web_source/activity.js: resultEnter, layoutResult, onAgainClicked, onHomeClicked, openAnswers

interactiveElements.action: pin_press, hook animateResultOut, activityReset, go to quiz
pin_press, hook animateResultOut, activityReset, go to intro

dynamicTexts.path: result.scoreFormat with {score},{max}; <small> tags removed; Arabic digits via activityToArabicDigits

flow: enter: summary = state.resultSummary (or built from state); hide kite/sparks/angled box/close/info; stars, notes, texts set
hooks in source order: kite leg 1, seal+sticker, title+stars in, confetti, star lit per earned star, score count-up, kite leg 2, reminder, buttons
again: reset + quiz; home: reset + intro; answers: overlay
warnings: Answers overlay elements are not in the result build; handler is bound but inert until they exist on this frame.
Answers overlay chips (check/cross icons and colors) are not ported.
Score <small> styling is not possible in a plain text field; the number and 'من' + max are one plain string.
Texts are set on the first text child of the clip the build creates for each text element.
